verbalization: Nimustine is shown to have a target relationship with two distinct entities: UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1-3 and Voltage-dependent T-type calcium channel subunit alpha-1I. The latter is targeted by Selenium (75Se) norcholesterol, which in turn targets Corticosteroid 11-beta-dehydrogenase isozyme 2. This suggests that the relationship between Nimustine and Corticosteroid 11-beta-dehydrogenase isozyme 2 may be indirect, through the intermediate of UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1-3. The evidence supports a pathway where Nimustine's effects are mediated through the metabolic processes of UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1-3, which is itself targeted by a compound that interacts with Corticosteroid 11-beta-dehydrogenase isozyme 2. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential mechanism by which Nimustine may influence the activity of corticosteroid metabolism, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
